tex_content.html:
Lemma
[the tangent bundle is a smooth manifold]

↗ ex:dc-ch0-4-1

1. ch0:4.1The tangent bundle $TM$ of a smooth $n$-manifold $M$ carries a smooth manifold structure of dimension $2n$, modelled on $H\times E$.
Proof

\sketch

The charts $\mathbf{y}_\alpha $ of section 3 form a differentiable atlas: the transition maps $\mathbf{y}_\beta ^{-1}\circ \mathbf{y}_\alpha (q,v)=\big((\mathbf{x}_\beta ^{-1}\circ \mathbf{x}_\alpha )(q),\, d(\mathbf{x}_\beta ^{-1}\circ \mathbf{x}_\alpha )(v)\big)$ are smooth, being built from the smooth change of coordinates on $M$ and its differential. Hence $TM$ is a smooth manifold modelled on $H\times E$.

□
